messages.content: What is the current time in New York City?

function.name: weather_forecast_get
function.description: Retrieve the current weather forecast for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location you want to retrieve the weather for.

hour.description: The hour of the day in 24-hour format (optional). If not provided, the current hour will be used. Default: 24

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time data, so I can’t tell you the exact current time in New York City right now. If you need the precise time, you might check a reliable world clock or your device’s time settings.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "What is the current time in New York City?" We need to provide the current time. We don't have real-time data. But we can approximate using UTC offset. New York City is Eastern Time Zone. Current time depends on DST. We can compute approximate time based on UTC. But we don't know current UTC. We could say "I don't have real-time data" or we can approximate. The best approach: explain that I can't fetch real-time data. But we can approximate if we know the current UTC. But we don't. So we should respond that I cannot provide real-time data. Alternatively, we can use the function to get weather forecast, but that doesn't give time. There's no function for time. So we should respond that I don't have real-time data.
